pages.title: Showcase: what the engine can and can not draw
XSLT 4 in a browser: maps, records, xsl:switch, new functions
FOAF explorer (JavaScript)
pages.needs: page scripts in foafnaut (BubblePopJS in the app and on the Hub): requestAnimationFrame, createElementNS, setAttribute and click events
pages.shows: a FOAF graph explored by expansion: a tap brings in a person's friends; the page's own force layout (springs, repulsion, cooling) writes one transform per moved person and one path for all links per frame, and stops when it settles; ?debug shows fps and script time
pages.doesNotShow: dragging: script events carry no pointer coordinates in foafnaut yet

pages.title: FOAF explorer, verified overlap check (WebAssembly)
pages.needs: page scripts and page WebAssembly in foafnaut (WebAssembly.instantiate, exports.check, exports.memory)
pages.shows: the FOAF explorer drawing only frames that pass the Lean overlap certificate, checked by a 353-byte WebAssembly function proved in Lean, on its bytes and under the WebAssembly spec semantics, to compute LayoutPolicy.certify (theorem FoafCheck.page_check_certifies); the status line counts frames checked and held
pages.doesNotShow: a proved layout: the springs and repulsion are the page's own unproved JavaScript; the label widths in the footprints are estimates

pages.title: JavaScript in Foafnaut: status
pages.shows: WPT and Test262 counts for page scripts on BubblePopJS and on QuickJS in WasmVM, and the speed of guest Wasm translated for the Hub

pages.title: Images
pages.shows: img as a replaced element drawn by Lean: inline on the baseline, vertical-align middle, block, width only, max-width 100% in a narrow box, border and padding, object-fit, alt text for a missing image, and pre keeping its spaces
pages.doesNotShow: srcset, picture, lazy loading, images from other sites, and object-position other than the centre

pages.title: FOAF to SVG through XSLT
pages.shows: RDF/XML FOAF read by XSLT 3.0; people on a circle with math:sin and math:cos; knows links as curves, mutual links found; a table; interests counted; Latin, Armenian (fallback font), Greek and Cyrillic names
pages.doesNotShow: Factoidal's RDF parser (the stylesheet reads one RDF/XML layout); SVG text (labels are glyph outlines set by XSLT, issue 1270)

pages.title: SPARQL results through XSLT
pages.shows: real SPARQL 1.1 results from Factoidal's engine over foaf-people.xml, as Query Results XML; XSLT makes a table from the variables and a two-sided bar chart
pages.doesNotShow: a query run by the browser: the query ran once, ahead of time, with the factoidal command

pages.title: A feed reader with no JavaScript
pages.shows: an Atom feed with an XSLT 3.0 stylesheet: entries sorted and grouped by day, dates in words, a strip chart of entries each day
pages.doesNotShow: a built-in feed view for a feed that names no stylesheet; RSS 2.0 and RSS 1.0 (issue 1287)

pages.title: Sitemap explorer
pages.shows: a sitemap of these demo pages: XSLT 3.0 date arithmetic, sorting by lastmod, grouping, a bar chart of pages changed each day, priority bars in table cells
pages.doesNotShow: a built-in sitemap view; re-sorting by a click

pages.title: Tables that compute
pages.shows: file counts, lines and bytes of labs/demos/foafnaut; XSLT computes totals, shares and means into a CSS table, and draws a ring chart with SVG arcs and a bar chart
pages.doesNotShow: numbers aligned right or bold totals (text-align and font-weight are dropped, issue 1273)

pages.title: The engine explains itself
pages.shows: an XML description of foafnaut's stages, drawn by XSLT 3.0 as an SVG diagram with gradients, dashes and glyph-outline labels, and as a table of Lean files and proof files

pages.title: Typography lab
pages.shows: the Lean shaper (kerning, ligatures, mark positioning, fallback font) beside the same strings set as unshaped glyph outlines by XSLT; a size ladder
pages.doesNotShow: bold or italic: one face, and font-weight and font-style are dropped (expected failure, issue 1273)

pages.title: Print-ready poster and cards
pages.shows: three sheets on screen; on paper, @media print rules hide the screen note and colours, break-before starts each sheet on a page, break-inside: avoid keeps each card whole (3 pages on A4)
pages.doesNotShow: page numbers, running headers and @page margins

pages.title: Timers and clicks
pages.needs: page scripts in the engine (scriptSession: BubblePopJS, or QuickJS-NG in WasmVM)
pages.appRefused: a host with no QuickJS guest module refuses a page with scripts when QuickJS-NG is chosen
pages.shows: twelve SVG dots eased between grid, ring and bars by requestAnimationFrame, auto-played by setInterval; buttons with click listeners; centred with text-align and auto margins
pages.doesNotShow: CSS transitions or SVG animation elements: the script moves each dot

pages.title: WebGPU triangle, checked by Lean
pages.needs: page scripts and the page GPU commands (gpu_command import, L4Factoidal.PageGpu) in the engine and the guest
pages.shows: a spinning triangle drawn by the page with navigator.gpu at about 24 frames a second; Lean validates every command and shader, and draws the canvas into the page
pages.doesNotShow: readback, textures, compute, WebGL; without the new engine the canvas stays blank and the page says the script has not run

pages.title: WebGL 1 and 2, checked by Lean
pages.needs: page scripts and the page GPU commands with WebGL programs (gpu_command op 9, L4Factoidal.PageGpu.Glsl) in the engine and the guest
pages.shows: two spinning triangles, one drawn with getContext('webgl2') and GLSL ES 3.00, one with getContext('webgl') and GLSL ES 1.00; Lean translates both to its WGSL subset
pages.doesNotShow: textures, index buffers, depth, blending, readPixels

pages.title: WebAssembly in a page
pages.needs: page scripts and the WebAssembly JavaScript API (wasm_call import, L4Factoidal.WasmVM.Hosts.PageWasm) in the engine and the guest
pages.shows: a 310-byte module (wasm-mandelbrot.wat) instantiated by the page's script; Lean runs it in WasmVM; the script reads its memory through Memory.buffer and draws eight SVG paths; clicks zoom; a JavaScript import is called once per row
pages.doesNotShow: Canvas drawing, streaming compilation; without the new engine the page says the script has not run

pages.title: A Canvas 2D chart, drawn by Lean
pages.needs: page scripts and Canvas 2D (gpu_command ops 200 and 201, L4Factoidal.PageCanvas) in the engine and the guest
pages.shows: an animated bar chart with a gradient, a line with round joins, dots and text labels, drawn by getContext('2d') each animation frame; Lean rasterises every pixel
pages.doesNotShow: images from the network; without the new engine the canvas stays blank

pages.title: Spın̈al Tap: a SPARQL client for Wikidata
pages.needs: page scripts in the engine (BubblePopJS or QuickJS-NG in WasmVM); fetch for live queries to QLever, else the inlined snapshot (tools/spinal-tap-snapshot.py, third_party/data/wikidata-spinal-tap)
pages.shows: the band's name in Mathematical Fraktur letters (Noto Sans Math) with chrome, a black cut line and a flame edge, and a diaeresis over the 𝔫 that is U+0308 in the text, placed by the shaper (issue 368); seven SPARQL queries with syntax highlighting; Wikidata results as amp-panel cards with dials that go to eleven, built in one DOM batch; a zoom from 1 to 40 between the two dots that fades into 𝔉𝔬𝔞𝔣𝔫𝔞𝔲𝔱; up to eleven combining marks a letter
pages.doesNotShow: the band's own logo or any picture from Wikimedia Commons; U+0308 after a Fraktur letter (Foafnaut does not place marks from another font yet, so the dots are SVG); without fetch the results are the snapshot's, not live

pages.title: SVG text labels
pages.shows: SVG text drawn with the held fonts: names in Noto Sans and Noto Sans Armenian beside their circles, and a caption along an arc (since bebb931ba)

pages.title: Open Index Search
pages.needs: page scripts with network access: XMLHttpRequest and script-inserted scripts (https://github.com/danbri/factoidal-core/issues/374)
pages.appRefused: a host with no script engine refuses a page with scripts
pages.shows: a search box that queries seven open sources (Wikidata, Wikipedia, OpenAlex, Crossref, Open Library, the Internet Archive and Wikidata SPARQL) in parallel
pages.doesNotShow: results in Foafnaut yet: the sources fail until page scripts have network access
